title: Getting around Malta
intro: Event travel runs on Malta Public Transport Route 186 between the Qawra/Buġibba corridor and the Ta' Qali stadium area, where the venue address for BLAST Arena Studios Malta (MFCC South Gate, Millennium Stand, Attard ATD 4000) is corroborated by independent listings and BLAST's own attendee guide for another event at the same venue (11 October 2026 check). Operator timetables show the last evening buses on the corridor at about 21:53–21:55 (one table variant), and Malta Public Transport lists a Route 186 diversion weekly on Friday and Saturday 19:00–00:00 starting 17 October. Night services reach Buġibba (N212) and Valletta (N13), but no night route serving Ta' Qali was verified. The operator's journey planner is the final check for the exact stop, direction, time and service alert on each date; the event's public match and door times were not available in the sources checked.

records.name: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 — dates and venue
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, Millennium Stand, Attard ATD 4000, Malta (Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre, Ta’ Qali, Ħ’Attard). The Thunderpick entrance, gate and attendee instructions are not confirmed.
records.hours: Official TWC page lists the overall event window 12–19 October 2026: arrival 12 October, media day 13 October, Group Stage 14–16 October, Playoffs 17–18 October, departure 19 October. It does not publish daily public match/door times or attendee instructions.
records.description: The official Thunderpick page confirms the overall window and phase dates and lists Malta as the location. A Thunderpick press release names BLAST Studios Malta as the Finals venue. Liquipedia places BLAST Arena Studios in Attard, and venue listings and BLAST’s attendee guide give the MFCC/Ta’ Qali address for the same venue. The venue address is therefore corroborated; the spectator entrance, tickets and daily public times are not.
records.notes: Official TWC page rechecked 11 Oct 2026 (still lists Malta only). Venue corroboration checked 11 Oct 2026: Liquipedia TWC 2026 page (location Attard; venue BLAST Arena Studios): https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Thunderpick/World_Championship/2026 ; Thunderpick press release naming BLAST Studios Malta: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-returns-to-malta-with-1-million-prize-pool-302850221.html ; visitmalta directory address for BLAST Arena Studios: https://www.visitmalta.co.uk/business-directory/business/blast-arena-studios-malta ; EventWorks listing for a BLAST event at the same venue (30 Jul 2026): https://eventworks.mt/premier-bounty-presented-by-polymarket ; BLAST attendee guide for BLAST Bounty at BLAST Arena Studios, giving the MFCC/Ta’ Qali address: https://blast.tv/cs/news/malta-fan-guide . Do not transfer earlier BLAST event access rules or door times to the Thunderpick Finals.

records.name: Qawra ↔ Ta’ Qali / BLAST Arena Studios — Route 186
records.address: MPT timetable lists Qawra stop 952 and Ta' Qali “Stadium” stops on Route 186 (6227 in one stop-table variant, 2194 in another — the route page carries several parallel tables). Whether those stops or another give the easiest walk to the BLAST Arena Studios entrance is not verified; confirm in the planner.
records.hours: MPT's static Route 186 timetable (re-checked 11 Oct 2026) lists Qawra stop 952 at 30-minute intervals from 06:09 to 21:39 in one table variant (06:10–21:38 in another). The normal Rabat-to-Buġibba return runs via St Paul's Bay/Buġibba, not the Qawra seafront; its last listed arrival at Buġibba Bay 1 appears as 21:26–21:36 across the table variants and was not re-verified for a trip date. Use the live planner for date-and-time-specific departures; this is not a trip-day guarantee.
records.description: Route 186 is the clearest direct bus candidate found for the event commute: the operator's route timetable lists both Qawra stop 952 and a Ta' Qali stadium-area stop. From Qawra, select the Rabat-bound service; from Ta' Qali, select the Buġibba-bound return. The standard return continues via St Paul's Bay/Buġibba rather than Qawra's seafront. The route page carries several parallel stop-table variants whose stop IDs and times differ, so stop-level values are indicative. These are route-level timetable details, not a confirmed hotel-to-venue itinerary or a guarantee of a trip-day return. Confirm the walk to the BLAST Arena Studios entrance, event-time departures, the onward hotel connection and any service alert in the live planner.
records.notes: Route stop rows re-checked 11 Oct 2026 on https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/186/ (the Qawra - 952 row; the Ta' Qali “Stadium” stop appears in parallel stop-table variants as both 6227 and 2194, with differing times, so no single stop ID is treated as definitive). For the Saturday 17 October evening detour, see the separate Route 186 notice. The journey planner is https://www.publictransport.com.mt/journey-planner/. Fare rates: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/ (re-checked 11 Oct 2026; see the fares record for the current table and seasonal caveat).
records.price range: Regular day-route fare; MPT lists €2 winter / €2.50 summer cash-contactless rates, but the applicable 2026 October fare window was not established

records.name: Route 186 — Mosta-corridor stop-level evening times (parallel table variants)
records.area: Ta' Qali / Mosta / Naxxar corridor on the route page's stop tables
records.address: Route 186 stops on the Mosta corridor, including Gholja 2 (1101 in one variant), Mithna (1099), Trincetta (6428), H'Attard and the Ta' Qali “Stadium” stop (6227 / 2194 in parallel variants)
records.hours: Operator stop-level timetables (checked 11 October 2026) show roughly half-hourly passes on the Mosta corridor until about 21:53–21:55 in one table variant (final listed passes: Gholja 2 at 21:53, Mithna at 21:54, Trincetta at 21:55; H'Attard 21:58; Ta' Qali stops 21:59–22:04; Rabat 22:08–22:11). A parallel variant with older stop IDs shows last passes around 21:01–21:05 on the same stretch. No pass after about 22:11 through the corridor was shown in the late-day table rows.
records.price range: Single-journey fare is published on the operator's fares page; its stated seasonal window does not cover the trip dates, so check the current fare
records.description: The Route 186 page shows several parallel stop-table variants whose stop IDs and evening times differ, so this record records the observed late-evening pattern rather than a single definitive timetable. In both the newer and the older variant, the corridor's last evening passes fall in the 21:00–22:11 range, which makes the bus workable for early-evening travel but leaves no clearly advertised late service through the corridor, so a late event exit needs a different plan. Direction labels are not consistent across the page's variants, so this record deliberately does not assign a direction; confirm in the planner.
records.notes: Times read from the operator's Route 186 page on 11 Oct 2026 at stops Gholja 2, Mithna, Trincetta, H'Attard, the Ta' Qali “Stadium” stop (6227 in one table variant, 2194 in another) and the Rabat-area stops. The same page displays a stop closure at Saqqajja (ID 4627) affecting routes including 186 until 1 January (as displayed) and the weekend-evening diversion recorded separately in this dataset. The operator's journey planner is the authority for a given date, direction and stop.

records.name: Night routes — late-return options from Buġibba and Valletta
records.hours: Malta Public Transport's own announcement (changes effective 5 April 2026) states N212 departures from Buġibba run Monday to Sunday between 23:50 and 01:30 every 20 minutes, and N13 Valletta departures run on weekdays from 23:10 to 02:10 every 10 minutes.
records.price range: The operator's announcement states night routes are part of the free public transport service and that holders of a valid Tallinja card travel free; card eligibility and conditions were not independently verified
records.description: Late-night bus coverage exists at Buġibba (N212) and Valletta (N13) according to the operator's April 2026 announcement. Whether any night route serves Ta' Qali or Attard — the venue area — was not established, so a late playoff exit may still need a taxi or ride-hailing backup.
records.notes: The announcement is about route changes effective 5 April 2026; the operator's separate generic page for night routes returned 'page not found' when checked on 11 Oct 2026, so exact 13–19 October 2026 night timetables were not confirmed. Buġibba-area stops on the operator's route pages list N48 and N212 among 'other routes operating from this bus stop'. Recheck the tallinja app or planner for the night of travel.

records.name: Route 186 diversion — Saturday 17 October evening
records.address: Route 186 toward Buġibba; affected stops listed by MPT are Gholja 2 through Targa
records.hours: MPT notice: 19:00 to approximately 00:00, starting 17 October and ending 18 October 2026
records.description: A currently published Malta Public Transport notice says Route 186 is diverted on Friday/Saturday evenings from 19:00, starting 17 October, and that stops from Gholja 2 through Targa toward Buġibba will not be served. This overlaps the TWC Playoffs weekend and may matter for the return journey. The notice does not publish TWC-specific service details; check the live planner and service updates before relying on a particular stop or departure. The same Friday/Saturday 19:00–00:00 window also affects several other routes in the Mosta/Naxxar corridor (103, 45, 47, 202, 203, 238, 260, 280, 31, 41, 42, 48 and N48). The operator does not state a cause.
records.notes: Re-checked 11 Oct 2026 on the MPT route page service-update box and the MPT service-updates page: weekly Friday/Saturday 19:00–00:00 detour starting 17 October, ending 18 October; toward Buġibba, stops from Gholja 2 through Targa are not served. Friday 16 October is before the stated start, so this notice covers Saturday 17 October evening. The notice specifies affected stops, not a total cancellation of Route 186. Recheck on the day. The same service-update page lists long-running closures outside this route (for example routes 52/201 to Dingli until 30 June 2027 and Marsaxlokk Sunday services 81/210/119), which may matter for day trips.
records.price range: Normal route fare; no separate event fare stated

records.name: MPT weekday/weekend timetable transition for 13–19 October
records.hours: Weekday winter timetable began 21 September 2026; weekend winter timetable begins 7 November 2026
records.description: For this trip, 13–16 October and Monday 19 October fall under the operator’s weekday winter timetable; Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 October remain on the summer weekend timetable. This is a network-level schedule transition only; route-specific departures, journey duration and disruptions must still be checked for each event date.
records.notes: MPT Route 186’s current published notice separately lists the 17 October evening diversion: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/latest-service-updates/.
records.price range: Fare depends on route/card and the applicable seasonal fare period

records.name: Route 214 — alternate Qawra / Ta’ Qali service to compare
records.address: MPT timetable lists Qawra stop 952 and Ta’ Qali stop Qali 2 (2542); walking access to MFCC not verified
records.hours: Check the date-specific planner; do not infer departure time or MFCC walking time from the route name
records.description: MPT’s Route 214 timetable lists both Qawra and Ta’ Qali stops, so it is a second service to compare in the journey planner. Route 186 lists the Ta’ Qali Stadium stop, while Route 214 lists Qali 2; the planner must determine which stop gives the safer/easier walk to the actual MFCC entrance on the selected date.
records.notes: The Route 214 page showed a detour notice for 11 October only when checked; it is outside the trip window, not a guarantee of unchanged service later. Journey planner: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/journey-planner/. Re-check 11 Oct 2026: stop IDs and the 952 Qawra row were not re-verified for Route 214 on this date.
records.price range: Regular day-route fare; exact October 2026 seasonal fare not established

records.name: Malta Airport ↔ Qawra by Airport Direct TD1
records.area: Malta International Airport ↔ Qawra / Buġibba / north Malta
records.address: Airport bus terminal; MPT’s Route TD1 timetable includes Qawra stop Arznell 950. Confirm the stop nearest the hotel entrance in the planner.
records.hours: MPT lists TD1 departures hourly; use the live timetable for the flight arrival time
records.description: This is the most straightforward published public-bus option from Malta International Airport toward Qawra: Airport Direct TD1 runs from the airport toward Cirkewwa via Buġibba and the Qawra area, and its operator timetable lists the Arznell stop in Qawra. The airport terminal is signposted from arrivals. Buses have luggage space; no advance booking is required. The precise walk from the stop to AX ODYCY was not independently measured.
records.notes: Route stop and times: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/TD1/. MPT also lists TD5 Airport Direct toward Rabat/Buġibba hourly at €3; its Qawra suitability was not established here. Operator information and fares: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/.
records.price range: €3.50 per passenger on TD1 without an eligible unlimited travel card; cash or contactless onboard

records.name: Malta Airport ↔ Qawra by Route 214
records.address: MPT Route 214 timetable lists Qawra stop 952; confirm the best hotel-side stop in the journey planner
records.hours: See the operator’s Route 214 timetable and planner for the flight date/time
records.description: Route 214 is another scheduled airport connection and its official timetable lists Qawra stop 952. It may be useful if its departure fits the flight arrival, but compare the live routing and walking distance with Airport Direct TD1 before choosing.
records.notes: Airport Direct fares and airport-terminal information: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/other-services/airport-direct/. Regular route fare chart: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/.
records.price range: Regular day-route fare; exact fare window for October 2026 not confirmed

records.name: Bus fares and visitor travel cards
records.address: Tickets may be purchased onboard by cash or contactless; sales points and machines are listed by MPT
records.hours: Tickets on bus; card validity depends on the selected product
records.description: Malta Public Transport's fares page (re-checked 11 October 2026) displays a winter single fare of €2.00 valid for 2 hours, tied to the period “19 October 2025 to 13 June 2026”, alongside a fares table listing Day Routes winter €2.00 / summer €2.50, Night Routes €3.00, Special Services €3.00, Tallinja Direct €3.00 and TD1 €3.50. Because the displayed validity window does not cover 13–19 October 2026, the rate applying to the trip was not established by the page. Travel cards listed: 12 Single Day Journeys €19 (12 journeys on Day Routes; night and Airport Direct trips count as 2 of the 12; shareable; valid six months from first use); Explore Flex 4 days from €21 and 7 days €27; Explore Adult 7-Day €25 (unlimited Day and Night Routes, excludes tallinja Direct Routes); Explore Child 7-Day €7 (ages 4–10; under 4s travel free); Airport Direct two trips €6. Tickets can be bought on the bus with cash or a contactless card; a €50 fine applies without a valid validated ticket.
records.notes: Sales and collection points listed on the same page: sales offices inside the airport Welcomer's Hall and at baggage reclaim, the Valletta Terminal, the Buġibba Terminal and Sliema Ferries; card-dispensing machines in tourist areas including the airport; retail outlets including Agenda Bookshops, 8TillLate and WH Smith (https://www.publictransport.com.mt/office-and-ticket-machine/). The Buġibba Terminal office is the nearest listed sales office to the Qawra seafront hotel area, but the walking route and distance were not measured. Tallinja-card free-travel rules and TD-route inclusions differ from visitor cards; check the product terms rather than assuming all buses are free. Recheck fares and card terms for the trip dates before purchase.
records.price range: MPT's fare table (re-checked 11 Oct 2026): Day Routes €2.00 winter / €2.50 summer single (2-hour validity and transfers); Night Routes (N) €3.00; Special Services (S) €3.00; Tallinja Direct (TD) €3.00 and TD1 €3.50; 12 Single Day Journeys €19 (shareable, six months from first use); Explore Flex from €21 (4 days) / €27 (7 days); Explore Adult 7-Day €25; Explore Child 7-Day €7 (ages 4–10; under-4s free); Airport Direct two trips €6. Which seasonal single rate applies to 13–19 October 2026 is not settled by the page text.

records.name: Ride-hailing and taxi options
records.address: Pickup/drop-off is set in the operator app or agreed with the taxi provider
records.hours: App availability and taxi dispatch depend on live supply; Malta Taxi advertises 24/7 service
records.description: Bolt and eCabs provide app-based ride-hailing; Malta Taxi advertises app/phone booking, vehicle tracking and 24/7 service. These are the practical door-to-door alternatives when a bus connection is late, the event ends after useful departures or luggage is inconvenient. Compare the app quote and pickup pin at the time; no exact event transfer price or car availability is guaranteed here.
records.notes: Operator pages: eCabs https://ecabs.com.mt/ and Malta Taxi https://www.maltataxi.mt/ (phone advertised: +356 2182 3017). Malta Taxi’s self-description as the only official licensed taxi company was not independently verified and is not relied upon. Bolt airport pickup instructions: https://bolt.eu/en/airports/mla/.
records.price range: Live quote required; no trip fare independently verified

records.name: Rental car pickup at Malta International Airport
records.address: Park East, Level 1 (lower level), about a three-minute walk from the terminal, per Malta International Airport
records.hours: Rental desk/vehicle availability depends on the chosen company and reservation
records.description: Malta International Airport says pre-booked rental-car offices and keys are in the separate Park East building, a short walk from the terminal. Hiring a car can help with flexible sightseeing, but it is not necessary to reach Qawra or the Ta’ Qali event area by the published bus routes. Do not assume walk-up availability or a particular rental price.
records.notes: The airport page lists participating rental firms. Driving-side and road-safety advice is covered in the Everyday Guide; rental terms, parking and event-day congestion were not priced or checked.
records.price range: Not quoted; compare date-specific rental, insurance, fuel and parking charges

records.name: Valletta ferry — Sliema and Three Cities
records.address: Operator terminals at Valletta, Sliema and the Three Cities; confirm the correct sailing/landing point
records.hours: Operator publishes summer and winter timetables; the summer timetable runs through 31 October, but check the exact date, Sunday/public-holiday service and weather
records.description: Valletta Ferry Services is useful for crossing the Grand Harbour between Valletta and Sliema or the Three Cities, not as an island-wide substitute for buses. The operator page provides fares and seasonal timetables; these are current published prices, not a promise of a sailing during disruption or bad weather.
records.notes: Confirm the departure, last return, weather and any public-holiday change on the operator site before making a connection.
records.price range: Published adult day single/return €3/€5; night single/return €3.50/€5.20

records.name: Gozo Channel conventional ferry
records.address: Gozo Channel terminals at Ċirkewwa and Mġarr
records.hours: Check the operator’s live timetable, sailing status and ticket conditions
records.description: Gozo Channel is the conventional vehicle/passenger ferry between Malta and Gozo and is a useful option for a Gozo day trip. This is a separate excursion from the Qawra–Ta’ Qali event commute; plan both island-side buses and the return crossing rather than relying on a posted fare alone.
records.notes: Fare and passenger eligibility are subject to the operator’s conditions and can change. Check current schedules and terminal notices before travel.
records.price range: Current passenger tariff lists a standard €4.65 adult fare; ticketing/return conditions must be checked with the operator

records.name: Gozo Highspeed passenger ferry
records.address: Use the operator’s terminal instructions for the selected Malta departure and Gozo arrival
records.hours: Check the operator’s date-specific timetable and live notices; restrictions were displayed for 14 and 17 October 2026
records.description: Gozo Highspeed publishes faster passenger-ferry connections and route-dependent fares. On the operator page checked 9 October, schedule restrictions were shown for 14 and 17 October in connection with the Rolex Middle Sea Race, alongside temporary pedestrian-route works at Mġarr through 31 October. The exact effect on a particular sailing was not established; verify before booking or setting an island day trip.
records.notes: Operator fares and service alerts: https://gozohighspeed.com/pages/fares. Check the timetable/terminal access notice for the precise departure date and time.
records.price range: Published standard adult one-way fares: Valletta €7.50, Sliema €8.50, Buġibba €6.50
